info.title: Ziqx Dockyard Service API
info.summary: Privileged VPS deployment agent — initial staging implementation
info.description:
All /v1/* calls require TLS 1.3 mTLS plus seven signed request headers. The client leaf certificate DER SHA-256 is pinned to the HMAC key; root policy limits its scopes/projects. HMAC signing keys stay on the backend/operator client. A browser viewing docs uses a trusted operator client certificate through its certificate store.

Signing input is LF-separated UTF-8 with no trailing LF:

deploy-agent-v1
serverID
keyID
timestamp
idempotencyKey
actorID
requestID
canonicalScopes
HTTPMethod
exactRequestTarget
lowercaseHex(SHA256(rawBody))

X-Deploy-Signature is lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of that input. serverID comes from root policy. exactRequestTarget includes the escaped path and exact raw query in transmitted order. Scopes are sorted, unique, single-space-separated; timestamp skew is at most 60 seconds. Duplicate headers/JSON keys/query keys, unknown JSON/query fields, encoded/noncanonical paths and controls are rejected. GET bodies are forbidden. Maximum body is 128 KiB.

Mutations return durable 202 jobs. Reuse operation/request IDs and identical actor, method, target, scopes and exact raw body for retries; refresh timestamp/signature. Transport keys may rotate. The original acceptance envelope remains queued; poll the job for current status. One outstanding job per project; one global FIFO worker. Unknown side effects block mutations pending local recovery.

These are custom signed scopes, not OAuth scopes. x-required-scopes documents each operation's permissions. New environment snapshots, including inline Compose environments, additionally need deploy.environment. All new deployments require compose_yaml; stateless blue-green stacks support multiple services, and stacks with managed named volumes require single-slot mode. Health/documentation resources require only mTLS at the agent listener. The bundled documentation viewer is read-only and never executes API operations or contacts external services.

SQLite is the authoritative metadata store. Project, domain, release, job and audit inventory reads use stored state without project file/Docker/Caddy reads. Native service update eligibility additionally verifies the current immutable Compose manifest. Status/log/deploy/recovery operations still inspect live dependencies and verify immutable files. Service inventory describes recorded slot bindings, not current running health.

Existing /docker projects and effective Caddyfile host/upstream metadata are observed into SQLite at startup and every five minutes. Legacy projects are classified as production inventory without adopting Docker/Caddy ownership. GET /v1/inventory requires deploy.read and all-project access, and reads only cached safe metadata. Source warnings/timestamps distinguish stale observations; observed ports remain reserved.

Individual service updates preserve the complete Compose project and its dependencies. Seamless service updates are production-only and switch only the routed stateless app; stateful services use restart.

get.description: Only projects allowed for this signing key are returned.

post.description: Full Compose projects require an explicitly configured compose.admin grant and projects: ["*"] for the authenticated key, in addition to the signed operation scopes. Full Compose grants root-equivalent server control. Creates /docker/<id> files, reserves domains/ports and installs maintenance. Existing directories are rejected. Omit ports to allocate. A nonzero secondary_port requires zerodowntime=true and differs from port. Wait for success before first deployment. Requires app_id and an explicit environment choice. App/environment is unique and immutable; deploy the same app in the three environments through distinct project IDs. Full Compose projects default to a single instance; compatible production stacks can opt into blue-green. Legacy template projects keep their production default. Blue-green true outside production returns BLUE_GREEN_PRODUCTION_ONLY; duplicate app/environment returns APP_ENVIRONMENT_EXISTS. Missing environment returns HTTP 422 DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT_REQUIRED.

post.description: Requires Compose YAML and an explicit environment matching the project. Full Compose mode requires a server-wide key with a configured compose.admin grant, plus signed deploy.execute and deploy.environment scopes. Docker Compose validates and resolves YAML and raw env_file contents before a durable job is accepted. Referenced external files must exist on the VPS. The job starts the stack and verifies running/healthy state; optional Caddy routing switches after those checks. Single-instance deployment can interrupt service; blue-green is production-only and requires independent stateless stacks with healthchecks. Full Compose can deploy to stopped projects. Legacy template projects retain their existing restricted validation and require start first. Missing environment returns 422 DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT_REQUIRED; a mismatched environment returns 409 DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH.

Read recorded service inventory from SQLite. Native active services additionally verify the immutable Compose manifest and report update eligibility and dependency names, without Docker queries or environment values. Includes both recorded slots; candidates/old slots may be stopped, failed or draining. Use status/log endpoints for live checks.

Read assigned and conservatively retained reserved domains with recorded Cloudflare IDs from SQLite. Does not test DNS propagation, Caddy coherence or public TLS. Older hostname-to-record associations populate on the next DNS job/reconciliation.

get.summary: Read existing Compose and Caddy inventory
get.description: Requires deploy.read and all-project access. Returns safe cached SQLite observations of existing /docker Compose projects, effective Caddyfile host/upstream mappings and retained observed ports. Legacy projects are classified production and remain unmanaged; no adoption, environment-secret reads, Compose execution, Caddy reload or container changes occur during sync. GET performs no scan. Source timestamps/warnings indicate freshness; failed sources preserve their last success, missing directories remain present=false, and ports remain reserved. Aliases/interpolation/overrides may leave metadata incomplete; this is not live health or a full backup. Caddy associations use only unambiguous loopback published ports.

200.description: Cached inventory, including incomplete/stale observation warnings.

get.summary: Review adoption of an existing Compose project
get.description: Requires deploy.read and all-project access. Reads live Docker Compose configuration and verifies the exact container IDs, project name, source files and working directory. Returns a review hash without Compose source or environment values. Does not change containers, volumes, ports or Caddy routes.

200.description: Adoption review; execution_available is true when live checks pass.

post.summary: Adopt a reviewed existing Compose project in place
post.description: Requires projects.write, deploy.environment, credential compose.admin and all-project access. Revalidates source_sha256 before acceptance; changed sources return MIGRATION_SOURCE_CHANGED. Stores private Compose/environment snapshots in /docker/<inventory-id> and binds exact existing container ownership. Returns a durable metadata job. Preserves original source files, Compose project name, volumes, ports and Caddy routes. Future redeploys are single-instance and can interrupt service; existing Caddy routes are not edited by this project.

get.summary: Read saved Compose and environment files
get.description: Returns verified source Compose and raw .env for the current release, or empty files and release_id for an undeployed project. Contains secrets: requires signed deploy.environment and server-wide compose.admin authority. Responses are no-store. The desktop requires Touch ID before fetching. Read-only metadata endpoints never include these contents.

post.description: Requires server-wide compose.admin. Validates the proposed Compose/.env and pins approval to the current release, route source, and allocated ports. Existing persistent mounts are not duplicated or stopped. Imported routes must be plain reverse_proxy sites in the main Caddyfile. Preview writes private validation snapshots but never changes live services or routes. Enable starts green, checks health, switches traffic, drains, and stops the original. Unknown outcomes require reconciliation; backups remain in the private job journal.

200.description: Review fingerprint, domains, web service, and blue/green ports. No Compose or environment contents returned.

post.description: Requires server-wide compose.admin. Restart updates only the selected service. Seamless requires production, a routed app, a healthcheck and safe concurrent versions; it preserves databases and dependencies, switches the reviewed Caddy route, drains requests and stops only the previous app. Use the current full Compose release ID. Preview makes no live changes. Execute requires the preview review hash and returns a durable service_update job. Unchanged image IDs skip deployment. Unknown outcomes require local recovery.

post.description: Requires server-wide compose.admin, sites.write and projects.write. Verify a running adopted Compose release and its existing published IPv4 port. Import the complete detected plain Caddy site group, or create a route when no existing domains are detected. Compose files, containers, volumes and published ports remain unchanged. Preview has no side effects; apply requires its review hash and returns a durable route_setup job. Active/recovery jobs and stale reviews block admission. Unknown route outcomes require offline recovery. Existing published routes retain a pinned service/port binding; managed route edits cannot migrate that port.

get.description: Requires deploy.read. Returns the job admitted for an idempotency key, or 404 if that key was never admitted. Signed requests expire after 60 seconds, so a 404 after that is definitive.
Requires deploy.read for the job's project. Returns every durable status/phase change of the job, oldest first, with timestamps and fault codes. Docker command output is never included.

post.description: Requires deploy.execute for the job's project, and server-wide compose.admin for Compose projects. Runs the same verified reconcile as `dockyard -reconcile-job` inside the daemon, so no VPS shell is needed. Containers are never started, stopped or relabeled; only the observed state is recorded and the job is marked failed with JOB_INTERRUPTED_RECONCILED. Adopted Compose stacks are identified by their source project, working directory and config files, so containers recreated in the source folder are recognized. Body must be an empty JSON object.

200.description: Recovery recorded; the lock is released when no other job needs recovery

MutualTLS.description: Verified TLS 1.3 client certificate. /v1/* additionally pins its leaf DER hash to the signing key.

HMACSignature.name: X-Deploy-Signature
HMACSignature.description: Fresh 64-hex request HMAC, not a reusable token. Requires the six additional headers and the exact signing protocol in info.description.

KeyID.name: X-Deploy-Key-ID
KeyID.description: Configured signing key, pinned to the client certificate.

Timestamp.name: X-Deploy-Timestamp
Timestamp.description: Canonical Unix seconds, at most 60 seconds clock skew.

Scopes.name: X-Deploy-Scopes
Scopes.description: Sorted unique known scopes, separated by single spaces. 1–10 scopes, within key policy.

Idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency.description: Stable mutation operation key; also required for authenticated reads.

Actor.name: X-Actor-ID
Actor.description: Attributable actor asserted by the signing backend.

RequestID.name: X-Request-ID
RequestID.description: Stable request ID for retries. Cannot be reused under another mutation key.

Error400.description: Invalid, duplicate, unknown or out-of-policy input, unsafe/invalid Compose YAML, or persistent volumes in blue-green mode.

Error401.description: Signature, freshness, certificate pin or authentication failed.

Error403.description: Scope, key policy or project permission denied.

Error404.description: Resource or retained release not found.

Error409.description: Project/port/domain/identity conflict, busy/stopped state or history/redaction limit.

Error422.description: First deploy is missing the required environment snapshot.

Error503.description: Dependency unavailable or recovery blocks admission.

Hostname.description: Canonical lowercase ASCII/Punycode hostname, with at least two labels. Each label is 1–63 characters with no leading/trailing hyphen. IP literals/wildcards are rejected. Must satisfy root domain policy.

zerodowntime.description: Defaults false for Compose projects. Only production allows true, with Caddy routing, independent stateless services and explicit healthchecks. Legacy template projects default true in production.

port.description: Omit/0 to allocate on creation or retain on a route update. Subject to root port policy.

secondary_port.description: Omit/0 to allocate on creation or retain on a route update. Subject to root port policy.

app_id.description: Logical application shared by its development, staging and production deployments. One project per app/environment; each project has a separate authorized ID and runtime resources.

route_service.description: Optional Caddy target service. Required with domains for Compose projects.

readiness_path.description: Optional HTTP path on the routed service for readiness checks.

variables.description: Legacy template projects only. New Compose projects use env_file contents.

compose_yaml.description: Compose YAML, maximum 64 KiB UTF-8. Full Compose projects use the installed Docker Compose validator and accept multiple services, image tags/digests, builds, mounts, networks and volumes. Referenced external files must exist on the VPS. No template or app service requirement. Blue-green has additional compatibility checks.

env_file.description: Raw .env file contents, not a filesystem path. Up to 64 KiB in UTF-8. Used for Compose interpolation and env_file: .env. Omit to reuse the current snapshot, or supply an empty string to clear. Full Compose mode only; requires deploy.environment.

expected_release_id.description: Optional optimistic concurrency check against the current release. An empty string requires an undeployed project. A mismatch returns CONFIGURATION_CHANGED before any files are prepared.

port.description: Omit/0 to allocate on creation or retain on a route update. Subject to root port policy.

secondary_port.description: Omit/0 to allocate on creation or retain on a route update. Subject to root port policy.

release_id.description: Retained successful release ID. Omit/empty for preceding activation.

confirmation.description: Must exactly equal the path project ID.

image.description: Must use the template's exact allowed GHCR repository.

x-dockyard-template.description: Required on companions; app uses the project template.

environment.description: Literal, write-only service environment; per-template allowed/required keys and 8192-byte value limits apply. New maps require deploy.environment.

items.description: Literal container argument; 1024 UTF-8 byte limit. No host shell interpretation.
Literal container argument; 1024 UTF-8 byte limit. No host shell interpretation.

depends_on.description: Must refer to existing services; cycles rejected. Agent enforces service_healthy.

ports.description: App only. Omit for automatic loopback publishing. If supplied, target must match root template; public binds rejected.

ComposeDocument.description: Legacy template-mode subset only. Full Compose projects use the installed Docker Compose schema.

volumes.description: Managed project-local named volumes, declared as empty objects. Every declared volume must be mounted; zero-downtime projects reject all volumes.

depends_on.description: Sorted dependency service names from the active immutable Compose manifest. Empty means none; null or omitted means metadata is unavailable for this slot or server version.

image.description: Recorded image reference; empty when only a build context is supplied.

compose_revision.description: Immutable normalized Compose revision. Omitted for legacy releases.

ServiceInfo.description: Recorded slot service inventory from SQLite. Does not assert the container is currently running/healthy. Legacy image values resolve from the recorded slot release.

assigned.description: Currently assigned to the project. False means a conservatively retained reservation.

dns_record_id.description: Cloudflare record ID recorded after a DNS job/reconciliation. Absence does not prove no DNS record exists.

DeploymentEnvironment.description: Required target choice. Development and staging use one Compose instance. Only production permits blue-green; selection must match the immutable project environment. This is distinct from secret environment variables/revisions.
DeploymentEnvironment.x-ui-question: Which environment should receive this deployment?

id.description: Stable observed ID; legacy IDs start with existing-. Does not grant mutation authority.

managed.description: True only for projects already controlled by Dockyard; legacy discovery remains false.

items.description: Fixed metadata parsing/ownership warning code; no raw source or diagnostics.

host_matcher.description: Effective Caddyfile host matcher, including wildcard/catch-all when present.

items.description: Static host:port dial target. Dynamic/socket targets are omitted.
